_about: Plutarch in English, translator per title. LIVES: Sir Thomas North (1579, from Amyot's French; Tudor Translations ed. George Wyndham, 1895-96, 6 vols., raw IA), John and William Langhorne (1770; 1813 printing, 6 vols., raw IA; vol. 4 is an 1844-46 printing), Aubrey Stewart and George Long (Bohn, 1880-82, 4 vols., clean Gutenberg). The 'Dryden' Lives revised by Clough is already held on the Adler shelf (plutarch-lives, PG 674); it is not Dryden's translation (lane C's Dryden shelf records that Dryden translated none of the Lives). MORALIA: the Goodwin edition, 'translated from the Greek by several hands' (1870; 5 vols., clean Gutenberg), Shilleto (Bohn), Holland's Roman Questions (1603, ed. Jevons 1892), Peabody's Delay of the Divine Justice, Tucker and Prickard's Selected Essays (1913-18). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.
